Welcome to **The Pond**, an interactive learning environment to learn how to make your science more open and reproducible.

Whether you are new to open science or looking to deepen your technical skills, The Pond is designed to let you learn by doing.

## Explore The Pond

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.card}
::: {.card-body}
### The Shallows

Start here to explore **why open science matters**. Learn about the ideas behind open, reproducible, and FAIR science and the problems these practices are designed to solve.

### LilyPads

Hop onto a LilyPad for **hands-on learning**. Explore self-contained modules, courses, and project workstations focused on **data, software, and scientific workflows**.

## Where should I start?

**New to open science?** Begin in [The Shallows](shallows/index.qmd).

**Looking for practical skills?** Jump straight to the [LilyPads](lilypads/index.qmd).

**Already comfortable with the basics?** Dive into [Deep Water](deep-water/index.qmd).
